urlText: Train trackwork on the T1 North Shore Line and City Circle may affect how you travel
content:
Saturday 5 and Sunday 6 April
  • Extra metro services run between Tallawong and Sydenham due to train trackwork on the T1 North Shore Line and City Circle.
  • Trains do not run between North Sydney and Central, or on the City Circle.
  • T1 North Shore Line trains run between Berowra and North Sydney only. Use metro services between Chatswood and the City.
  • Light Rail services run between Central and Circular Quay.

  • Plan your trip before you travel for up-to-date real time information. You can also subscribe to planned trackwork alerts.

urlText: Buses replace trains between Sutherland and Hurstville
content:
Monday 24 to Wednesday 26 March     
  • Nightly from 11pm to 2.30am, buses replace trains between Sutherland and Hurstville.
  • Trains run between Waterfall or Cronulla and Sutherland, and between Hurstville and Bondi Junction, some to a changed timetable.

  • Replacement buses for trackwork may be affected by driver shortages. We are doing all we can to minimise the impact to your journey and provide a safe service, however cancellations or delays may occur.
  • Plan your trip before you travel for up-to-date real time information. You can also subscribe to planned trackwork alerts.

urlText: Buses replace Inner West Line trains between Strathfield and Central. Leppington trains run to a changed stopping pattern
content:
Saturday 5 and Sunday 6 April
  • Buses replace Inner West Line trains between Strathfield and Central. Express trains continue to run.
  • Trains run to a changed timetable between Leppington and Olympic Park via Granville and between Leppington and Lidcombe via Regents Park.
  • Change trains at Lidcombe to continue your journey.
  • T1 Western Line Penrith trains make extra stops at Flemington, Homebush and Burwood.

  • Trackwork on the City Circle may also affect how you travel.
  • Replacement buses for trackwork may be affected by driver shortages. We are doing all we can to minimise the impact to your journey and provide a safe service, however cancellations or delays may occur.
  • Plan your trip before you travel for up-to-date real time information. You can also subscribe to planned trackwork alerts.
Bus routes
44T2 Strathfield, then all stations to Stanmore, then express to Central and return
47T2 Strathfield, then all stations to Central and return
